snippet.title: Kings Gauntlet: Chess Revolution - Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1646910/

Follow the development of the game on Discord: https://discord.gg/QTMXpmgpqX

👑 KG:CR is a high-paced chess-like multiplayer bullet hell 👑
Shoot at your opponent, summon chess pieces, dash around the arena and crush the enemy king! 
Choose from 8 characters with unique playstyles and conquer the Kings Gauntlet!

Music by Fuzzeke: https://youtu.be/rbwWsLetnDA
